title: Compact reporting range controls on admin overviews
summary: Admin and Super Admin overview pages now show compact reporting-range radio options and an Update range button instead of oversized form controls.
changes: Scoped analytics-range styles so radio inputs no longer inherit full-width form sizing.
Aligned reporting-range labels and the Update range button on a single compact toolbar row on Admin and Super Admin overview pages.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch release fixing oversized reporting-range controls on admin overview pages.
validation: Verified compact layout on Admin and Super Admin overview pages in local preview.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, the analytics-range CSS changes in resources/css/app.css, and related version-pinned tests. No database changes are required.
provenance: Defined by the reporting range controls sizing issue #81.
